provenance.source_access: Only question string decoded; no GT fields, papers, titles, search results, audits, or previous human judgments accessed.
provenance.query_id_assignment: Q0-Q49 = zero-based original JSONL line order
provenance.network: HF offline + local_files_only + Python audit hook denies Internet sockets during inference
provenance.extraction: Corpus-wide lexical scan; >=2 all-caps letters, optional plural s; mixed case alphabetic length 2-5 with >=2 uppercase and >=50% uppercase. Discover lowercase/plural aliases from this corpus only. Deduplicate normalized acronym within a query; retain all mentions. No acronym allowlist. Long camel case/underscore identifiers and numeric tokens excluded. Uppercase dataset/organization initialisms remain eligible (e.g. MBPP, IMO).
provenance.normalization: Expansion agreement uses Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapsed whitespace, typographic dash/hyphen -> space, trailing period removed. No semantic merging or gold judgments. Empty expansions vote as abstentions; parse failures never vote; denominator always 5.
provenance.translation: Chinese translations authored from original question by the assistant, preserving acronym spellings; review-only, never provided to Crawler. No gold expansion or correctness judgment generated.
provenance.seed_policy: 5 separate passes; each batch seeded with 2026091200 + run_index*1000 + batch_index; sequences have separate sampled token draws and no conversational history. run_index is 0-based.
provenance.use_cache_reason: Enable KV cache for speed; no sampling parameter override.
provenance.divergence_rule: SequenceMatcher ratio <0.5 between normalized nonempty expansions flags lexical divergence only; semantic difference requires human review.
